correctness.rationale: Use the 2-bit overlapping states and delete one transition in each phase. A time-two edge has a unique intermediate state determined by its endpoints; closed length-j paths count exactly the phase-labelled 2j-periodic strings including repeats. Thus the trace determinant formula gives the symbolic zeta function. Survivor cylinder counts come from summing entries of the alternating products and multiplying by 2^(-n-2). For even n these sums are comparable to an induced norm of P^(n/2); for odd n the terminal vector M_u1 has entries in [1,2], preserving the same growth exponent. The finite-state entropy and escape formulas follow. The unpunctured matrix has rank 2, hence each deleted-edge matrix and P have rank ≤3, so the first three traces determine the full determinant by Newton identities. Independent exact reproduction checked all 64 ordered pairs (including the static pairs) and 192 cyclic word counts: class sizes 8,16,12,8,16,4, the stated six cubic denominators and all triples agree. Rational disjoint brackets and monotonicity of each cubic from 5/2 establish strict Perron ordering; the end cubics give the squares of the golden and tribonacci constants. 000:000 and 000:001 both give (3,11) but have third returns 39 and 33, proving sharpness. value.rationale: This is a complete exact classification of a natural first moving-hole family where hole sizes and depths are held fixed and only the schedule varies. The six different rates exhibit real schedule effects, and the sharp finite return test and static/alternating spectral coincidences show exactly what short periodic data can and cannot recover. The value does not hinge on generalizing beyond this family.
